title: Casterwill Hunters
summary: The Casterwill Hunters are members of the Blood Spiral that are specially trained to kill members of the Casterwill family through any means necessary. Even more dangerous than the Silent Soldiers, they have no shame in destroying members of the Huntik Foundation for being allies of the Casterwills.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
A group of Casterwill Hunters accompanied Kiel to Medusa's Island to meet Stack who promised to recover Medusa. After Kiel was taken prisoner by the Huntik Foundation in Medusa's Cave, the Hunters arrived with Marduk, rescuing him and fighting Dante Vale. [Zhalia's Mission]

Two Casterwill Hunters traveled with Kiel and Marduk to the Cloisters in New York, USA in an attempt to discover the hidden hiding places of the Casterwill family. The two Hunters were defeated after a fight with the Huntik team on the roof of the Cloisters. [The Casterwill Connection] More of Kiel's Casterwill Hunters traveled to Mexico where they fought against Dante Vale outside the Pyramid of the Sun in an attempt to stop the activation of the Blue Star. [The Titan in the Temple of Sun] 

Hundreds of Casterwill Hunters traveled to the Great Rift Valley, Africa as part of the huge Blood Spiral army. [Sophie on Trial] They later fought against the Casterwill family in the attack on the Fortress of Iron Will. One group, led by Marduk, reached the top of the cliff face but were defeated by Nimue Casterwill who sacrificed herself. [The Spiral War]

A group of Casterwill Hunters ambushed the Huntik team on Phoenix' island, trapping Lok and Sophie in a lava tube. [The Dead Magic Island] More Casterwill Hunters were ambushed by the Huntik team before they descended into the volcano to find Phoenix. The Hunters were held off by Montehue and Tersly. [The Phoenix's Ashes]

On the longest night of the year, Marduk and his Hunters attempted to stop the team reaching Nostradamus' grave. After destroying their plane using Psikofen, the Hunters followed the team to the graveyard where they fought again. The Huntik team escaped using Umbra. [Words from Eathon] During the final battle, the Hunters fought the Huntik Foundation and Casterwill family. [Lok and the Betrayer] The Hunters fought until the defeat of the Betrayer. [Dante's Return]

sections.heading: Personality
sections.wikitext: The Casterwill Hunters, like the [[Silent Soldiers]], are trained to mindlessly follow the orders of their superiors within the [[Blood Spiral]] like fanatics. Trained to be efficient assassins, they will let nothing come in the way of ruthlessly killing off a member of the [[Casterwill family]] through whatever force necessary. They will even fight each other over who gets to disintegrate a Casterwill.{{source|The Casterwill Connection}}

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext:
[[File:S2E45 Harlekin Hunters.png|thumb|200px|The Casterwill Hunters and [[Harlekin]]]]
The Casterwill Hunters are violent and ruthless combatants, and are much stronger and difficult to take down than the average [[Silent Soldiers]]. They are skilled in martial arts, something [[Dante Vale]] noticed, {{source|Zhalia's Mission}} and are trained in using dark powers that can prove deadly. {{source|The Casterwill Connection}} Their arsenal of [[Titans]] are of a much greater variety than the lower level members of the Spiral, and these tend to be associated with darkness, shadows and death. Like the [[Silent Soldiers]], their principle fighting Titan is [[Harlekin]].
